name: Grappler
description: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you're grappling, and can try to pin a grappled creature (both restrained until the grapple ends).

name: Tavern Brawler
description: +1 STR or CON. You're proficient with improvised weapons, your unarmed strike die becomes a d4, and on an unarmed/improvised hit you can try to grapple as a bonus action.

name: Great Weapon Master
description: On a crit or a kill with a melee weapon, make a bonus-action attack. With a heavy weapon you may take -5 to hit for +10 damage.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Long-range shots don't suffer disadvantage, cover doesn't hinder your ranged attacks, and you may take -5 to hit for +10 damage.

name: Lucky
description: 3 luck points per long rest. Spend one to roll an extra d20 on an attack, check, or save (yours or an attacker's) and pick which die to use.

name: Alert
description: +5 to initiative, you can't be surprised while conscious, and hidden attackers gain no advantage against you.

name: Mobile
description: +10 ft speed; Dashing ignores difficult terrain; after a melee attack on a creature, you don't provoke opportunity attacks from it.

name: Tough
description: Your hit-point maximum increases by 2 per character level.

name: Resilient
description: +1 to one ability score, and you gain saving-throw proficiency in that same ability.

name: War Caster
prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
description: Advantage on concentration saves, you can cast with hands full of weapon/shield, and you can cast a spell as an opportunity attack.

name: Magic Initiate
description: Learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from a chosen class; the 1st-level spell is castable once per long rest without a slot.

name: Ritual Caster
description: You gain a ritual book and can cast spells from it as rituals; you can add more ritual spells you find.

name: Sentinel
description: Opportunity-attack hits stop a target's movement; foes that Disengage still provoke from you; you can react when a nearby creature attacks someone else.

name: Polearm Master
description: Bonus-action butt-end attack (1d4) with a polearm, and creatures provoke an opportunity attack when they enter your reach.

name: Shield Master
description: Bonus-action shove with your shield, add the shield's AC to DEX saves against single-target effects, and turn a failed save into no damage.

name: Dual Wielder
description: +1 AC while wielding two weapons, you can two-weapon-fight with non-light weapons, and you can draw/stow two weapons at once.

name: Crossbow Expert
description: Ignore the loading property, no disadvantage for ranged attacks in melee, and a bonus-action hand-crossbow shot after a one-handed attack.

name: Defensive Duelist
description: When hit while wielding a finesse weapon, react to add your proficiency bonus to AC, possibly turning the hit into a miss.

name: Savage Attacker
description: Once per turn you may reroll a melee weapon's damage dice and use either total.

name: Mage Slayer
description: React to attack a caster who casts in your reach, impose disadvantage on their concentration saves, and gain advantage on saves against their spells.

name: Spell Sniper
prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
description: Double the range of your attack-roll spells, ignore half/three-quarters cover, and learn one attack-roll cantrip.

name: Elemental Adept
prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
description: Spells of a chosen damage type ignore resistance to it, and treat any 1 rolled on their damage dice as a 2.

name: Inspiring Leader
description: Spend 10 minutes to give up to six allies temporary hit points equal to your level + your Charisma modifier.

name: Healer
description: Use a healer's kit to restore 1d6+4 HP plus the target's hit dice, and stabilize-and-heal a downed creature for 1 HP.

name: Skilled
description: Gain proficiency in any three skills or tools of your choice.

name: Observant
description: +1 INT or WIS, read lips, and a +5 bonus to passive Perception and passive Investigation.

name: Actor
description: +1 CHA, advantage on Deception/Performance to pass as someone else, and you can mimic speech or sounds you've heard.

name: Athlete
description: +1 STR or DEX, stand from prone with little movement, climb at full speed, and make running jumps after only 5 ft of movement.

name: Charger
description: After a Dash, use a bonus action to attack for +5 damage or shove a creature 10 ft.

name: Keen Mind
description: +1 INT, always know which way is north and hours until sunrise/sunset, and recall anything you've seen or heard in the past month.
